title: Minimum Attendance Requirement
content: Students are expected to maintain at least 75 percent attendance in their courses. Students whose attendance falls below the prescribed threshold may receive academic attention and may be required to contact the concerned faculty or academic office.

title: Attendance Shortage
content: Students with attendance below the required threshold should review their attendance record and contact the concerned course faculty if they believe an attendance entry is incorrect. Attendance-related issues can also be submitted through the UniSphere Helpdesk.

title: Semester Examination Process
content: Students should check the examination schedule, examination centre, reporting time and examination instructions before appearing for a semester examination. Students should carry the required university identification or admit card where applicable.

title: Digital Certificate Verification
content: Digital certificates issued through UniSphere can be verified using their certificate identification number and verification mechanism. A valid certificate should display the student's relevant certificate information and verification status.

title: Bonafide Certificate
content: A bonafide certificate confirms that a student is enrolled with the university. Students can request or access eligible digital certificates through the certificate service in UniSphere.

title: Hostel Allocation
content: Hostel allocation depends on university hostel availability and applicable institutional rules. Students should review their hostel allocation, room information, hostel fee status and complaint records through the hostel service.

title: Hostel Complaints
content: Students can submit hostel-related complaints such as maintenance, Wi-Fi, electrical or facility issues through the UniSphere helpdesk or hostel complaint service. Each complaint receives a trackable status.

title: Fee Payment
content: Students can review their semester fee, paid amount, outstanding amount and due date through the UniSphere fee service. Payment records should be retained for future reference.

title: Helpdesk Requests
content: Students can submit requests relating to academics, hostel, transport, fees, certificates and other university services through the UniSphere Helpdesk. Each request receives a ticket number and status.

title: Academic Support
content: Students experiencing academic difficulties may receive academic counselling, faculty review, attendance reminders or other appropriate interventions based on academic indicators and university processes.

title: Student Privacy
content: Student academic and administrative information should only be accessed by authorised users according to their role and applicable university policies. Students should not share authentication credentials with other people.

title: Attendance Policy Hindi
content: उपस्थिति के लिए सामान्य न्यूनतम आवश्यकता 75 प्रतिशत है। यदि आपकी उपस्थिति कम है तो UniSphere में रिकॉर्ड देखें, शिक्षक से संपर्क करें और आवश्यकता होने पर Helpdesk टिकट बनाएं.

title: Fee Payment Hindi
content: फीस, भुगतान, बकाया राशि और देय तिथि UniSphere के Fees और Payments section में देखें। भुगतान के बाद रसीद सुरक्षित रखें और किसी अंतर के लिए Helpdesk का उपयोग करें.

title: Hostel and Transport Hindi
content: Hostel आवंटन, कमरे की जानकारी और शिकायतें Hostel service में उपलब्ध हैं। बस route, वाहन और transport issue Transport service में देखें या रिपोर्ट करें.

title: Parent Portal Hindi
content: Parent Portal केवल linked student की academic summary, attendance, fee status और alerts दिखाता है। किसी दूसरे छात्र की निजी जानकारी उपलब्ध नहीं होती.

title: AI and Privacy Hindi
content: UniSphere AI university knowledge और आपके authorised account context के आधार पर सहायता करता है। पासवर्ड, OTP, token या API key कभी साझा न करें.
